therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: cellular replacement of insulin-secreting beta cells
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: restoration of endogenous insulin secretion and glycemic regulation
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Achievement of insulin independence at 12 months post transplant

results.effect_size: 1 out of 4 patients achieved insulin independence at 12 months
results.target_engagement_evidence: Mean islet equivalent per kilogram recipient body weight: 8717 IEQ/kg; mean number of infusions needed: 2
biomarker_changes: Mean insulin requirement reduced by 34.3% at 12 months in patients who did not achieve insulin independence
Mean GFR (renal function) at 12 months: 127.3 ml/min
Mean hypoglycemic episodes: 7.3 per month at 12 months
safety_signals: Elevated liver function tests in all 4 patients (serious adverse event)
Nausea and vomiting in 1/4 patients (serious adverse event)
Abdominal pain in 1/4 patients (serious adverse event)
2 of 4 participants experienced serious adverse events related to immunosuppression regimen
3 of 4 participants experienced serious adverse events related to islet cell infusion

dose_info.schedule: mean of 2 infusions to achieve insulin independence

results_by_chain.mechanism_description: cellular replacement of insulin-secreting beta cells
results_by_chain.biology_description: restoration of endogenous insulin secretion and glycemic regulation
results_by_chain.population_description: patients with Type 1 Diabetes enrolled in a Phase 1 islet transplantation study
